assertionShape (012B AC-3 clarification,: P1 Public operations are derived from the document at test time (every operation without `x-internal: true`); never a transcribed list.

P2 Every public operation has at least one composed studio MSW handler (handlers.ts + authoringHandlers.ts + schedulingHandlers.ts; method + '*/api/v1/studio' + path with `{x}` → `:x`) OR is an allowlist entry.
P3 Every studio MSW handler maps to a documented public operation (zero handlers for compile/confirm-compile and zero under /api/v2/studio).

P4 Every allowlist entry names an operationId that is present and public in the document AND has no handler; an entry whose operation has gained a handler, left the document or became internal fails the test as stale ('remove the entry'). This makes the allowlist self-shrinking and enforces the OBS-008 obligation mechanically.

P5 The allowlist is a closed literal kept in studioContract.test.ts (outside the module under test — VAC-11 precedent), keyed by operationId; each entry carries {operationId, class, owner, reason}. A new public operation without a handler and without a PO-ruled entry fails closed.

P6 One negative control per direction recorded in 012B evidence: remove one existing handler (e.g. GET /executions/:id) → P2 red; add a dummy handler for one allowlisted operation → P4 red; both restored.
